decisions: Ordinary vessels heat7U of hull material; large vessels preserve their separately defined100U mass.
Recipe REV quantities are independent of thermal mass: vanilla Stone63/45/27U, quartz gem output SiO2 with7/5/3U, Carbon hulls contain Graphene plates with7/5/3U.

OP.stone has default amount -1. OreDictItemData CR.REV ignores nonpositive components.40 stone-prefix-only source recipes have no positive recorded amount; no guessed63/45/27U registration or empty-shell recovery is fabricated.
ANY.Quartz hull stats/quality come from stolen MilkyQuartz; its reversible recipe output material is SiO2.
Mold/faucet use their own1-hardness source registration and utility hand exemption; basin/crossing retain their own source registrations.
Smeltery temperature limits truncate the original melting-point multiplier; source Steel2046K limit2557K.
Saved gt.mold shape is read through the native block-item adapter; source raw-nonzero fallback and25-bit nugget material loop are retained.
The original prefix category key is oredict.prefix; native itemCasing maps to original casingSmall. All50 selected Chinese values exactly match the patch.
Source crossing defines no specialized tooltip rows. General blast/harvest/material rows are emitted once by existing common/native material handlers.
Configured or stored block items remain excluded from empty-shell recovery.
boundaries: Source adaptation and prepared installed probes. No complete survival chain, player screen-hover, actual heating/damage world ticks, independent saved-world restart, historical save compatibility or dedicated-server acceptance implied.
